title: Web Workers: Keeping the UI Thread Responsive During Inference
meta_title: Web Workers for Browser Inference — ReLU.chat
meta_description: Why inference must run off the main thread: transferable buffers, worker pools, and keeping requestAnimationFrame smooth in on-device AI.
author: ReLU.chat
excerpt: Inference is compute, and compute does not belong on the UI thread. Here is how dedicated workers, transferable buffers, and worker pools keep a browser-based AI chatbot responsive.
